period AS (

      WHEN text ~ 'week|สัปดาห์' THEN ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date - interval '7 days')::date

)

  count(*) as meals,
  coalesce(sum(calories),0) as calories,
  coalesce(sum(protein_g),0) as protein_g,
